core_obligations: Rewrite and expand: local cohomology with support in the closed point equals local cohomology with respect to the maximal ideal and is the homotopy colimit of the internal homs out of the quotients by the powers of that ideal (proof lines 3651-3657)

Replace the pieces: those internal homs are isomorphic, compatibly with the transition maps, to the internal homs out of the same quotients into an injective hull, shifted in degree zero (proof lines 3658-3664)
Identify the colimit: the hull is the union of its truncations, so the colimit is the hull itself and every other cohomology module of the complex vanishes (proof lines 3665-3668)
proof_roadmap: 由 local-cohomology-noetherian：RΓ_m = RΓ_Z；再由 local-cohomology-ext：RΓ_m(ω_A^•) = hocolim RHom_A(A/m^n, ω_A^•)。
取 E' 为剩余域注入壳；由 dualizing-finite-length 得与过渡映射相容的同构 RHom_A(A/m^n, ω_A^•) ≅ Hom_A(A/m^n, E')[0]。
由 union-artinian：E' = ∪ E'[m^n] = colim Hom_A(A/m^n, E') ⇒ E ≅ E' 且该复形其余上同调为零。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement identifies the zeroth local cohomology of a normalized dualizing complex, with support in the closed point of a Noetherian local ring, with an injective hull of the residue field, and shows the complex has no other cohomology (author lemma at source lines 3641-3648, label lemma-local-cohomology-of-dualizing). The proof (source lines 3650-3670) rewrites the local cohomology as a homotopy colimit of internal homs out of the finite length quotients, replaces each term by the corresponding truncation of an injective hull compatibly with the transition maps, and identifies the resulting colimit with the hull through the description of the hull as the union of its truncations (proof lines 3658-3668). The comparison of the homotopy colimit with the hull is the substance. H3.
